label: Recreate table Story
summary: Recreates table Story to apply schema changes: database/Story/column:mediaUrl; database/Story/foreign-key:postId->.Post(id); database/Story/column:postId

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure temp table "_prisma_new_Story" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure table "Story" has exactly the columns the rebuild copies or leaves out (caption, createdAt, expiresAt, id, mediaUrl, userId)
precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Story')) = 6 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Story') WHERE name IN ('caption', 'createdAt', 'expiresAt', 'id', 'mediaUrl', 'userId')) = 6

execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_Story" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_Story" (
  "caption" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "mediaUrl" TEXT,
  "postId" TEXT,
  "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY ("postId") REFERENCES "Post" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)
SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

postcheck.description: verify "Story" is stored as the rebuilt table
postcheck.sql:
SELECT (SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'Story') = 'CREATE TABLE "Story" (
  "caption" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime(''%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ'',''now'')) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "mediaUrl" TEXT,
  "postId" TEXT,
  "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY ("postId") REFERENCES "Post" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pragma_table_info('Story') WHERE name = 'mediaUrl' AND "notnull" = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pragma_table_info('Story') WHERE name = 'postId' AND "notnull" = 0

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('Story') f WHERE f."table" = 'User' AND f.on_delete = 'CASCADE' AND f.on_update = 'NO ACTION' GROUP BY f.id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN (f."from", f."to") IN (('userId', 'id')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('Story') f WHERE f."table" = 'Post' AND f.on_delete = 'CASCADE' AND f.on_update = 'NO ACTION' GROUP BY f.id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN (f."from", f."to") IN (('postId', 'id')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)
